Propose label words from the prose

Source: R/lint-prose.R
label_seed.Rd

Reads the project's .qmd and .Rmd documents and counts each capitalised word that is followed, in the same block, by a typed number ("Site 3", "Stage 2"). Such words are candidates for the label_words setting, which exempts the number after them from the numeral lint. Cross-reference words (Figure, Table, ...), common function words and words already in label_words are left out. Nothing is written.

Usage

label_seed(paths = NULL, min_count = 2)

Arguments

paths

NULL (every document of the project the working folder is in, by the rules of dict_seed()), or document paths.

min_count

The fewest times a word must occur to be listed.

Value

A data frame with word, n (how many times), files (in how many files) and where (up to three places as <file>:<line>: <word> <numeral>), sorted by n and then word.
